features.name: Head
features.description: The rounded proximal articular region faces the glenoid cavity. Its margin is delimited by the anatomical neck, separating the smooth head from the tubercles.

anchor.reviewNote: Rounded articular head viewed from medial.

features.reason: Representative point on the licensed reduced mesh. Independent anatomical review is pending.

features.name: Anatomical neck
features.description: A groove bordering the head and providing attachment to the shoulder joint capsule. It is proximal to the surgical neck and should not be used as a synonym for it.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Greater tubercle
features.description: The lateral proximal prominence bears superior, middle and inferior tendon impressions for supraspinatus, infraspinatus and teres minor respectively.

anchor.reviewNote: Gross prominence lateral to the head, above the shaft.

features.reason: Representative point on the licensed reduced mesh. Independent anatomical review is pending.

features.name: Lesser tubercle
features.description: The anterior proximal prominence receives subscapularis. The intertubercular sulcus separates it from the greater tubercle.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Surgical neck
features.description: The narrowing immediately distal to the tubercles connects the proximal expansion with the shaft. It is anatomically distinct from the rim around the head.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Body
features.description: The shaft has three surfaces and three borders. Its proximal and distal shape differ, and the deltoid tuberosity and radial groove interrupt an otherwise continuous cortical surface.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Condyle
features.description: The distal articular complex includes the capitulum laterally and trochlea medially. Adjacent fossae and epicondyles are important neighbouring features, rather than interchangeable names for these joint surfaces.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Anterolateral surface
features.description: The shaft surface between the anterior and lateral borders includes the deltoid tuberosity. Distal to this attachment it contributes to the origin of brachialis.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Anteromedial surface
features.description: The shaft surface between anterior and medial borders includes the continuation of the intertubercular region, a coracobrachialis insertion area and a distal brachialis origin area.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Posterior surface
features.description: The radial groove crosses this region. The lateral head of triceps originates superior to the groove and the medial head principally inferior to it.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Anterior border
features.description: The boundary between the two anterior shaft surfaces descends from the greater-tubercle crest toward the coronoid fossa; it is related to pectoralis major insertion proximally and brachialis attachment distally.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Medial border
features.description: The boundary between anteromedial and posterior regions extends toward the medial epicondyle. Distally it contributes to the medial supracondylar ridge and attachment of the medial intermuscular septum.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Lateral border
features.description: This boundary between anterolateral and posterior surfaces descends toward the lateral epicondyle, becoming the lateral supracondylar ridge distally. The radial groove crosses its middle region.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Capitulum
features.description: The rounded lateral distal articular prominence meets the fovea of the radial head. Its articular surface is mainly anterior and inferior.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Trochlea
features.description: The pulley-shaped medial distal articular surface fits the trochlear notch of the ulna and extends onto the anterior, inferior and posterior aspects of the distal bone.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Intertubercular sulcus
features.description: The groove between the proximal tubercles accommodates the tendon of the long head of biceps. Its floor and two lips have distinct muscle attachments.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Crest of greater tubercle
features.description: The lateral lip of the intertubercular sulcus provides insertion for pectoralis major and continues toward the anterior shaft border.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Crest of lesser tubercle
features.description: The medial lip of the intertubercular sulcus receives teres major. Latissimus dorsi attaches in the floor of the groove rather than on this crest.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Deltoid tuberosity
features.description: A roughened lateral mid-shaft insertion area for deltoid. It provides an orientation landmark and a useful reference when describing shaft attachments.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Radial groove
features.description: An oblique posterior shaft groove related to the radial nerve and profunda brachii vessels. Triceps origins lie on either side of this region.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Medial epicondyle
features.description: The larger medial distal projection gives attachment to the common flexor origin and ulnar collateral ligament. The ulnar nerve passes behind it.

anchor.reviewNote: Medial distal projection, beside the trochlea.

features.reason: Representative point on the licensed reduced mesh. Independent anatomical review is pending.

features.name: Lateral epicondyle
features.description: The lateral distal prominence gives attachment to the common extensor region and radial collateral ligament of the elbow.

anchor.reviewNote: Lateral distal projection, outside the olecranon fossa.

features.reason: Representative point on the licensed reduced mesh. Independent anatomical review is pending.

features.name: Coronoid fossa
features.description: The anterior depression above the trochlea receives the coronoid process of the ulna as the elbow flexes.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Radial fossa
features.description: The small anterior depression above the capitulum accommodates the radial head during elbow flexion.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Olecranon fossa
features.description: The large posterior distal depression accommodates the olecranon during elbow extension. A thin septum separates it from the anterior coronoid fossa.

anchor.reviewNote: Central depression on the posterior distal humerus.

features.reason: Representative point on the licensed reduced mesh. Independent anatomical review is pending.

features.name: Medial supracondylar ridge
features.description: A distal continuation of the medial border associated with the medial intermuscular septum and neighbouring muscle origins.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Lateral supracondylar ridge
features.description: The distal lateral ridge gives attachment to brachioradialis superiorly, extensor carpi radialis longus inferiorly and the lateral intermuscular septum.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.

features.name: Groove for ulnar nerve
features.description: The distal humerus has a bony channel immediately behind the medial epicondyle.
features.reason: Information exists. A reliable anchor on this particular mesh has not been established.
